Enable the extension with `filters: [panzoom]`. Set options under `panzoom:` in
the document header, under `#| panzoom:` in a code cell, or as attributes on a
selected markdown image. Cell and image options override document options.

## Selecting images

  | Setting                                                    | Applies to                                                               |
  | ---                                                        | ---                                                                      |
  | `panzoom: true` or `panzoom: auto`                         | Every figure and every image alone in its paragraph.                     |
  | `panzoom: false`                                           | No images in the document, including explicitly selected images.         |
  | `panzoom:` with an option map                              | Selected images only, unless the map includes `match: auto`.             |
  | `#| panzoom: true`                                         | All plots from that code cell. A cell option map also selects its plots. |
  | `.panzoom` on an image or div                              | That image, or every image inside the div.                               |
  | `.nopanzoom` on an image, or `#| panzoom: false` on a cell | Excludes the image or cell's plots.                                      |

See [selecting images](examples/d-selecting-r.qmd) and
[divs](examples/p-divs-r.qmd) for examples.

## Viewer options

"Document" means the document's `panzoom:` map; "cell/image" means a cell's
`#| panzoom:` map or an attribute on a markdown image.

  | Option          | Default                                   | Scope                | Description                                                                                                                                        |
  | ---             | ---                                       | ---                  | ---                                                                                                                                                |
  | `match`         | Selected images                           | Document             | Set to `auto` to select every figure and standalone image.                                                                                         |
  | `max-zoom`      | `4`                                       | Document, cell/image | Maximum screen pixels per image pixel.                                                                                                             |
  | `hint`          | `true`                                    | Document, cell/image | `true` or `show` shows the controls hint; `hide` starts hidden but allows toggling; `false` removes it. Opening by touch hides the hint initially. |
  | `caption`       | `true`                                    | Document, cell/image | Show the figure caption in the viewer.                                                                                                             |
  | `loop`          | `false`                                   | Document             | Wrap from the last gallery image to the first, and back.                                                                                           |
  | `fit`           | `auto`                                    | Document, cell/image | `auto`, `contain`, `height`, or `width`; see below.                                                                                                |
  | `desc-position` | Figure caption position                   | Document, cell/image | Place the caption and description at `bottom`, `top`, `left`, or `right`. Side panels move below the image on screens narrower than 769 px.        |
  | `css-class`     | None                                      | Document, cell/image | Add a class to the viewer for custom CSS.                                                                                                          |
  | `keys`          | See [Keyboard options](#keyboard-options) | Document             | Change keys for viewer actions.                                                                                                                    |
  | `group`         | Automatic for subfigures                  | Cell/image           | Give images the same group name to form a gallery. Also supported on `.panzoom` divs.                                                              |
  | `description`   | None                                      | Cell/image           | Markdown text below the caption. A cell can use a list with one description per plot, in order.                                                    |

With `fit: auto`, most images open whole, never larger than their real size.
Very wide images open at screen height, near the clicked spot; very tall images
open at screen width, from the top. Choose `contain` to always open the whole
image, or `height` or `width` to force the corresponding fit.

See [cell options](examples/f-cell-options-r.qmd), [captions and
descriptions](examples/g-captions-r.qmd), and [wide and tall
figures](examples/h-wide-and-tall-r.qmd).

### Document example

```yaml
---
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  max-zoom: 6
  loop: true
  desc-position: bottom
---
```

### Cell and image examples

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 8
#|   hint: false
#|   group: pressure
#|   description:
#|     - "Pressure against temperature."
#|     - "The same, on a log scale."

plot(pressure)
plot(pressure, log = "y")
```

![A beach.](beach.jpg){.panzoom fit="contain" desc-position="left" description="An afternoon by the sea."}
````

Unknown options and invalid values stop the render with a validation error.

## Keyboard options

Set `keys` in the document's `panzoom:` map. Each action accepts one key, a list
of keys, or `false` to disable its binding. Omitted actions keep their defaults.

  | Action | Default | Behavior |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `caption` | `c` | Hide or show the caption and description. |
  | `hint` | `h` | Hide or show the hint. |
  | `close` | `Escape` | Close the viewer. |
  | `reset` | `"0"` | Return to the opening view. |
  | `zoom-in` | `["+", "="]` | Zoom in. |
  | `zoom-out` | `"-"` | Zoom out. |

```yaml
panzoom:
  keys:
    caption: k
    hint: false
    close: [Escape, q]
```

A key is one character, or `Escape`, `Backspace`, `Delete`, or `Insert`. Each
key can serve only one action. Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys, Page Up, Page
Down, Home, and End have fixed behavior. Left and Right change gallery images;
Ctrl/Cmd+arrow pans when the image is larger than the screen.

## Color options

These options work at document, cell, and image scope. Colors accept CSS values,
a `_brand.yml` palette name, or a brand role such as `primary`. Quote hex colors
in YAML. `panel-colour` and `link-colour` are aliases.

  | Option             | Default              | CSS variable         | Applies to                          |
  | ---                | ---                  | ---                  | ---                                 |
  | `backdrop`         | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)` | `--panzoom-backdrop` | Layer over the page.                |
  | `panel-background` | Page background      | `--panzoom-panel-bg` | Caption band or side panel.         |
  | `panel-color`      | Page text color      | `--panzoom-panel-fg` | Caption, description, and hint.     |
  | `link-color`       | Page link color      | `--panzoom-link`     | Links in captions and descriptions. |

```yaml
panzoom:
  backdrop: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)
  panel-background: "#222"
  panel-color: white
  link-color: lightblue
```

See [color options](examples/n-color-options-r.qmd) for examples and [styling
with CSS](examples/o-css-r.qmd) for additional CSS variables and the viewer's
classes.
